name: EWE Rechenzentrum Osnabrück
notes: EWE business colocation page states its high-availability data centers are located in Oldenburg and Osnabrück, offering colocation, server rooms, redundant power/cooling, 100% green power, ISO/IEC 27001 and TÜViT TSI certification. No MW disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum Universität Osnabrück
notes: University data center building at Neuer Graben 29, Osnabrück; new build completed August 2019 per Heinze; university describes its Rechenzentrum as central backbone for IT-supported study, teaching, research and administration. No MW disclosed.

name: Landkreis Osterholz / Stadt Osterholz-Scharmbeck shared backup data center
notes: Official intermunicipal-cooperation (IKZ) page says district and city jointly use a backup data center in a district-owned building. No MW disclosed.

name: Telis Energie Deutschland Mehrum data center campus (Hohenhameln)
notes: Campus planned near Mehrum in Hohenhameln, Landkreis Peine: six buildings on about 380,000 sqm, at least EUR 1bn investment; council initiated FNP amendment/B-Plan 'Rechenzentrum'; citizen info events June 2026, construction targeted 2028; planned connection load about 500 MW for a multi-tenant colocation campus. Nature-conservation concerns reported (PAZ 2026-06-25).

name: Klinikum Peine container data center
notes: CANCOM reference: modernized data-center network for Klinikum Peine using containerized data center, NetApp All-Flash MetroCluster and Veeam/ProLion security tooling; local press reported the hospital's new data center fit into two containers.

name: Avacon Netzdatencenter Salzgitter-Watenstedt
notes: Avacon laid the foundation stone 2022-08-16 for a new network data center on its Salzgitter-Watenstedt site (~1,000 sqm, energy-network data); planned operation June 2023 with 900+ TB storage and 120 VMs; KO Technik lists commissioning support 2023-2024.

name: Landkreis Schaumburg central school IT data center
notes: Local press reports Landkreis Schaumburg school IT operates a central data center located in a former caretaker house. Exact capacity not disclosed.

name: Kreishaus Uelzen data center
notes: New Kreishaus Uelzen handed over 2022-06-27 includes a data center (plus population-protection control room and animal-disease crisis centre) per Depenbrock and architect references; about 15,000 sqm building, EUR 51m investment. No MW disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum Universität Vechta
notes: University of Vechta official page: the Rechenzentrum is a central institution responsible for planning, operation and administration of university-wide data processing, communication and information systems. Small institutional facility; no MW disclosed.

name: Rechenzentrum Verden GmbH (rzv / vit)
developer: Rechenzentrum Verden GmbH / Data Center Group / vit
notes: rzv is the technical service provider of vit (Vereinigte Informationssysteme Tierhaltung) in Verden (Aller), running the animal-breeding IT data center; Data Center Group brochure describes chiller replacement/modernization for efficiency. No MW disclosed.

name: YEXIO Brake Data Center (HOCHTIEF)
developer: YEXIO / HOCHTIEF Data Center Partner GmbH
notes: Sustainable edge data center planned at Otto-Hahn-Strasse in Brake (Unterweser); Baxtel lists planned year 2027, about 10,000 sqm; part of HOCHTIEF/Palladio YEXIO network of ~15 decentralized edge data centers (first opened Sept 2025 in Heiligenhaus); local reporting mentions EWE heat concept. Capacity not confirmed for Brake.

name: Sengwarden DC / Wilhelmshaven Data Center and Energy Park
notes: Large data center and energy park proposed for Sengwarden near Wilhelmshaven; project cost described as billions of euros, developer and capacity not disclosed; city concept-award material identifies energy, storage technology and data-center use.

name: WOBCOM Nordkopf Tower Data Center (WNT)
notes: Certified public business data center in Wolfsburg Nordkopf Tower (Hesslinger Str. 1-5); expanded to five floors; new floor tenant Host Unlimited (cloud/game hosting); regional internet node. No MW disclosed.

name: Demmin Data Center (Siedenbrünzow, NOYA)
notes: NOYA/ClimateChange Energy planned a large AI data center near Demmin/Siedenbrünzow (about 300 MW, EUR 1bn+); talks with grid operators failed over insufficient grid capacity - project abandoned; record kept as negative evidence.

name: Hochschule Wismar IT-Service- und Medienzentrum / Rechenzentrum
notes: University IT-service and media centre at Buergermeister-Haupt-Strasse 34, Wismar; primary university pages identify ITSMZ with separate data-center access; Huawei case study references data-center switching for the facility. No MW disclosed.

name: Dummerstorf Data Center Campus
developer: Undisclosed German investor; reported potential link to Freo Group
notes: Dummerstorf municipality negotiating a 30-hectare campus with up to 1.2 GW connection load; state-parliament answer said grid operator viewed a data-center settlement in Dummerstorf/Rostock positively; investor identity and commitments still uncertain - not yet a decided project (per Berliner Zeitung 2026-08).

name: Hanseatic and University City of Rostock Municipal Data Center (Toitenwinkel)
developer: Hanseatic and University City of Rostock; PBIT Systeme / DC-Datacenter-Group
notes: First municipal data center, spatenstich 2025-10-29 in Toitenwinkel; shell planned complete Q1 2026, overall completion September 2026; about EUR 6m, 300 kW IT load, 90 sqm white space in two data halls; serves the city and partners such as the Südstadt-Klinikum.

name: euNetworks Colocation Rostock
notes: Operational colocation facility listed at Lessingstrasse 26 / Rostock by multiple data-center directories; power capacity not disclosed.

name: University of Rostock IT and Media Center / Konrad-Zuse-Haus Data Center
developer: University of Rostock / State building agency Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
notes: University IT and media center in Konrad-Zuse-Haus, Albert-Einstein-Strasse 22; project references describe the data center as core communications infrastructure for all university locations. No MW disclosed.
